experiment.name: ibm_r1_boosting_graph_seed1337
experiment.description: Time-forward holdout with features restricted to the training window: can behaviour up to a boundary predict laundering involvement after it?. R1 cross-period detection transfer: fit on a completed 2-day detection window, freeze, and score the next window. Features and labels both come from the window being scored - retrospective detection, not forecasting.

dataset.name: ibm_aml_hi_small
dataset.label_definition: positive = the (bank, account) entity is the payer or the payee of at least one transaction whose published 'Is Laundering' flag is 1. IBM labels transactions; this entity label is derived, and it makes a launderer's counterparty positive as well
notes: SYNTHETIC: IBM AMLworld virtual-world simulator (Altman et al., NeurIPS 2023 Datasets and Benchmarks). Not evidence about real-world detection.
Entity is the (bank, account) pair; account strings are not globally unique (8 collisions across banks).
Amounts are native across 15 currencies (37% USD) and are not FX-converted; the amount column is 'amount', not 'amount_usd'.
The typology names live in the separate HI-Small_Patterns.txt and are deliberately not loaded: their group headers state the generating mechanism and its degree/hop parameter.
Version is derived from file size and mtime, not a content hash; the content hash is in data/manifests/ibm_aml_hi_small.json.

notes: SYNTHETIC: IBM AMLworld virtual-world simulator (Altman et al., NeurIPS 2023 Datasets and Benchmarks). Not evidence about real-world detection.
Entity is the (bank, account) pair; account strings are not globally unique (8 collisions across banks).
Amounts are native across 15 currencies (37% USD) and are not FX-converted; the amount column is 'amount', not 'amount_usd'.
The typology names live in the separate HI-Small_Patterns.txt and are deliberately not loaded: their group headers state the generating mechanism and its degree/hop parameter.
Version is derived from file size and mtime, not a content hash; the content hash is in data/manifests/ibm_aml_hi_small.json.
features are computed from the transactions inside the detection window they are scored for; no history before it is used.
task is retrospective detection: for each window, features and labels both come from the transactions inside that window, and the model is asked which entities of a completed period to investigate.
a fold fits on one window, freezes, and scores the next window - train.end <= test.start, so no calendar instant is in both.
membership follows only from the window an entity transacted in, never from its own last activity: no survivorship selection.
